notes: The intentional stand-someone-up sense is supported by both checked Cambridge and Oxford entries. A new context note makes clear that a speaker using the expression does not prove another person’s intent.
Plan targets of 20,000–30,000 include the existing 7,500. Actual remaining budget remains unknown; the plan does not authorize additional spending or claim all target audio is affordable.
Seed genre IDs romance-urban and street-dialogue are editorial pilot labels and require explicit mapping to the final unified expansion schema before ingestion.
